tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background on every inner page (All Books, authors, product, account, forms). Source: html/body in hp/hp.css, --au-page, --bk-page.

tokens.name: page-warm
tokens.usage: Warmer cream ground used behind the homepage video overlay and the Kitab Teras pages. Source: --cream.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Book cards, author cards, list cards and search fields. Source: --au-card, .hm-card.

tokens.name: surface-content
tokens.usage: Cards on content pages (About, FAQ, policies, forms). Source: --cnt-card.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fill for ghost-button hover, side-nav hover and inset panels on content pages. Source: --cnt-soft.

tokens.name: cover-well
tokens.usage: Square well behind a book cover so covers of any shape sit whole inside the card. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and chip outlines, search field outline. Decorative: 1.5:1 on page, so never the only cue for a control's edge. Source: --au-border.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Hairlines: tab bar top edge, banners, menu dividers. Source: --rk-border.

tokens.name: border-content
tokens.usage: Outlines of content cards, form inputs and the page hero. Source: --cnt-border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on page, surface-card and surface-content (13.5:1 light, 15:1 dark). Source: --rk-text / --a-text.

tokens.name: ink-content
tokens.usage: Text on content pages (hero titles, section titles, form labels) on surface-content and page. Source: --cnt-text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hero subtitles, notes, checkbox labels, on page and surface-content (5.7:1 light, 6.8:1 dark). Source: --cnt-mute.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand's action colour, used 170+ times: prices, category labels, links, outline buttons, active chips, focus borders. As text it reads on page and surface-card (6.5:1 light, 9:1 dark). Source: --au-accent, --x-accent, --a-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the filled primary button. Source: .bk-btn--buy:hover.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button (Buy now, Subscribe, form submit). In dark it is a softer coral than the accent text colour. Source: .bk-btn--buy, --cnt-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent-fill button (6.9:1 light, 7.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Hover tint for chips and outline buttons; the search field's focus halo. Source: --au-soft.

tokens.name: discount-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the discount tag ("20% off") behind accent text. The dark value is a cool blue tint, likely left over from an earlier palette; kept as the code has it.

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Accent inside the All Books mega-menu and profile menu, hover on Hindi Pakhwara nav links, and their focus outline. Source: --ab-accent, --pm-accent.

tokens.name: logo-red
tokens.usage: The ink of the Rajkamal logo files. Not used for UI.

tokens.name: wish-red
tokens.usage: Filled heart on a wishlisted book. An icon colour (3.7:1 on surface-card), not for text. Source: --rk-red.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Success: the "Added" state of Add to cart, in-stock and confirmation messages. Source: --x-good, --a-good.

tokens.name: on-good
tokens.usage: Label on a good fill (5.2:1 light, 8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions on page and cards (5.5:1 light, 8.3:1 dark). Forms use the near-identical #c0392b. Source: --x-bad, --a-bad.

tokens.name: toast-bg
tokens.usage: Toast pill background; inverts against the theme.

tokens.name: toast-ink
tokens.usage: Toast text on toast-bg.

tokens.name: toast-icon
tokens.usage: Round yellow disc behind the toast icon (cart, heart, check); icon drawn in #4a140c on it.

tokens.name: footer-bg
tokens.usage: Site footer background, both themes.

tokens.name: footer-ink
tokens.usage: Footer text on footer-bg (9.4:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Highlight ink on red offer banners and the footer (9:1 on footer-bg). Source: --bn-ink.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Kitab Teras (kt/) palette accent for decorative fills; not for text on page. Source: --clay.

tokens.name: tabbar-bg
tokens.usage: Floating bottom tab bar on phones and tablets (up to 1199px).

families.sans: "Google Sans Flex", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.serif: Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", "Times New Roman", "Noto Serif", serif

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page hero title, clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.6rem). One per page.

styles.name: card-heading
styles.usage: Headings inside cards and form side panels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a page title, in accent.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Safe, Trusted & Hassle-Free Returns. Help Always at Hand.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: मित्रो हिन्दी कहानी की अभूतपूर्व पात्र है।
styles.usage: Running text, book descriptions, policy pages.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Form inputs and selects. Search fields use 16px so phones do not zoom.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Author line on book cards (at 75% opacity), notes and small print.

styles.name: book-title
styles.usage: Book card title, clamped to 2 lines (0.86rem on phones).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: All buttons (0.78rem inside book cards, 0.74rem on phones).

styles.name: category
styles.usage: Uppercase genre line on book cards, in accent.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Author life dates and short quotes on author pages, at 80% opacity.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between price and struck price; tight icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between lines inside a book card's info block.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between Add to cart and the wishlist button; label to input.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The most used gap: chip rows, button groups, toolbar items.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Toast icon to text; book card padding on phones; grid gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Book card info padding; card stacks.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Form field spacing; side-panel card stacks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; book grid column gap.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Book grid row gap; form card padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Content card padding.

tokens.name: space-26
tokens.usage: Gap between main columns (forms, Hindi Pakhwara grid).

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter of the page column and header.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Page hero top padding.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Space above the footer at the end of a page.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of the page column and the nav pill.

tokens.name: book-card-min
tokens.usage: Minimum book card width in auto-fill grids; phones use 2 columns.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, search fields, tags, toasts. The site's default shape (109 uses).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, wishlist heart, toast icon, footer social buttons.

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: Page hero panel.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Content cards and form cards.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Book cards and the product offers box.

tokens.name: radius-banner
tokens.usage: Banners, newsletter panel, home tiles.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Form inputs, selects, textareas.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inset panels and menu items.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Thumb tracks and tiny marks.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting book card. Dark theme drops it and relies on the border.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Content card on hover, with the border turning accent.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Cards that rise on hover (home tiles, imprint cards).

tokens.name: shadow-tabbar
tokens.usage: Floating bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: Focus halo on inputs, paired with an accent border. The halo alone is about 1.3:1, so the accent border is what makes focus visible.

tokens.name: bp-small
tokens.usage: Very small phones: labels drop from compact menus.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Phone layout at and below this width (91 rules). Two-column book grid, bottom tab bar, sheets.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet layout up to here; 981px and up gets side panels.

tokens.name: bp-tablet-wide
tokens.usage: Up to here the floating bottom tab bar replaces the desktop nav links.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Full desktop nav pill starts.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Wider nav gaps; All Books format row appears.

tokens.name: bp-shelf
tokens.usage: Home shelves show exactly five cards edge to edge with the nav pill.
